served.rule: served as today's law = current.applicable_today (build_versions): a FRENCH wording held whose dates cover today. An act in force whose French wording of today is not held (original amended since, a newer consolidation not held, a text published only in German or English) is held and not counted as served.
served.sentence_fr: Lex détient 24 302 textes luxembourgeois ; il tient le libellé français d’aujourd’hui de 16 618 d’entre eux. Des 18 122 textes en vigueur détenus, 1 504 n’ont pas ce libellé : 1 416 dont seul l’original est détenu, modifié depuis ; 73 dont une version plus récente existe chez l’éditeur sans fichier publié ; 15 que l’éditeur ne publie qu’en allemand.
served.sentence_en: Lex holds 24,302 Luxembourg texts, 16,618 of them in today's French wording. Of the 18,122 texts in force held, 1,504 lack that wording: 1,416 held only in their original wording, amended since; 73 with a newer version at the publisher that has no published file; 15 the publisher publishes only in German.

shape.label_en: Codes held as the publisher's code states (XML)
shape.label_fr: Codes (états du code, XML de l’éditeur)
shape.reason: Each code is ONE long document with its own outline (livre, titre, chapitre, article) and a chain of dated states; the act row is typed (address, type, dates, status: every code carries them, from the publisher). A question reaches it by the code's name (alias, by code) or its routing line, then the outline walk inside it (7quater). Splitting a code into a pile of articles would lose the outline, its cheapest signal (5B:63).
shape.rule: code: ingest/repair_flags.py PARTS (address, type, title pattern)
shape.decided_by: repair-data, driver decision (reversible), 22/11/2026, against Kezhan Shi 14A §2

shape.label_en: Codes held only as the publisher's PDF compilation (Code de la sécurité sociale, Code de la route)
shape.label_fr: Codes en recueil PDF (sécurité sociale, route)
shape.reason: A compilation is a PILE of printed texts under one cover (the code, then laws, regulations, statutes of the funds), each with its own numbering; the shared fields of the act table describe the cover, not the texts inside. So each printed text is a node 'TEXTE' of the outline with its own title (repair rule P20 found three that started inside the previous one), the walk picks the printed text first, then its articles; an article is cited as an article of its printed text (compiled_from).
shape.rule: code: ingest/repair_flags.py PARTS (address, type, title pattern)
shape.decided_by: repair-data, driver decision (reversible), 22/11/2026, against Kezhan Shi 14A §2

shape.label_en: Budget laws (budget des recettes et des dépenses de l’État)
shape.reason: One document type, one copy a year, the same tables every year (receipts, expenses, articles of the budget): typed by year (the date column) and the table rows are the unit (K-PARSE-7). Questions are rare in an insurer's inventory; they are reached when the question names the budget or the year, never by meaning alone over their thousands of table rows.
shape.rule: code: ingest/repair_flags.py PARTS (address, type, title pattern)
shape.decided_by: repair-data, driver decision (reversible), 22/11/2026, against Kezhan Shi 14A §2

shape.label_en: Laws approving a treaty (with the treaty annexed)
shape.reason: A BUNDLE of two pieces about one treaty: a one-article approval law and the treaty text joined to it (annex rows); questions are about the treaty, so the unit read is the bundle, never the approval article alone. Typed fields exist (date, parties are not extracted).
shape.rule: code: ingest/repair_flags.py PARTS (address, type, title pattern)

shape.label_en: Laws conferring naturalisation on named persons (individual measures)
shape.reason: Individual measures naming persons, no rule of law: kept as held texts (the publisher's record), a pile nobody asks a legal question about; they carry personal names, so they are taken OUT of both search indexes (rule X1, article_flag 'personal_measure': vectors zeroed and kept apart, no keyword rows) and are never a source of answers. No field is extracted from them on purpose.
shape.rule: code: ingest/repair_flags.py PARTS (address, type, title pattern)
shape.decided_by: repair-data, driver decision (reversible), 22/11/2026, against Kezhan Shi 14A §2

shape.label_en: Collective agreements declared generally binding (by RGD)
shape.reason: One document type, many copies (one per sector, renewed): the sector and the period are fields a person names in two seconds (14A:83); the agreement is the annex of the RGD that declares it binding. Reached when the question names the sector or the agreement (the insurance sector's agreement is a named text), not by meaning over all sectors.
shape.rule: code: ingest/repair_flags.py PARTS (address, type, title pattern)
shape.decided_by: repair-data, driver decision (reversible), 22/11/2026, against Kezhan Shi 14A §2

shape.label_en: Local and temporary traffic rules (RGD on one road or place)
shape.reason: One document type, many near-identical copies (one road, one place, one period, one measure): the textbook typed collection. The fields (road, place, measure, dates) are in the title and dates; Lex does not extract the road and place into columns yet, so these acts are reached only through their routing lines and the question's own road or place words; a meaning search over 1,400 near-identical texts would return noise.
shape.rule: code: ingest/repair_flags.py PARTS (address, type, title pattern)
shape.decided_by: repair-data, driver decision (reversible), 22/11/2026, against Kezhan Shi 14A §2

shape.reason: Every law carries the same publisher fields (address, type, date, publication, entry into force, status, version dates, relations): a typed act table, filtered by code on the date asked, the status and a type the question names. Their CONTENT is not typed (no subject column answers a question; the owner keeps subject codes and EuroVoc out of retrieval), so after the filter the texts are reached as a pile: one routing line per act (14B:73-89), then each text's outline.
shape.rule: code: ingest/repair_flags.py PARTS (address, type, title pattern)
